title: Hecke Module Problem For Semisimple Theta
body_html:
Hecke Module Problem For Semisimple Theta

The theta draft introduces the multiplicity space

$$ \mathcal M_{\Sigma,\Sigma'} := \operatorname{Hom}_{K\times K'} (\rho_\Sigma\otimes\rho'_{\Sigma'},\omega). $$

It is intended to be related to Hecke algebras attached to the types $\rho_\Sigma$ and $\rho'_{\Sigma'}$.

The draft asks for a support-preserving isomorphism

$$ \mathcal H'(G_\beta//\rho'^0) \cong \mathcal H'(G'//\rho'_\Sigma) $$

and discusses whether there is an algebra monomorphism

$$ \mathcal H'(G'//\rho'_\Sigma)\to R_c[G']. $$

It also records the expected module compatibility

$$ \operatorname{Hom}_{K'^0} (\rho', \operatorname{Hom}_{K'_{0+}}(\kappa',\pi')) \cong \operatorname{Hom}_{K'} (\rho'\otimes\kappa',\pi') $$

as a module statement for the corresponding Hecke algebras.

None of these compatibilities is established in the current draft; they form the open Hecke-module layer of the semisimple theta correspondence.
